item.title: UNCOOKED ALERT: Oxford Biomedica said to ... - Part 4
item.description:
Oxford Biomedica, the FTSE 250-listed contact development firm for gene therapies, has come back under the spotlight amid renewed takeover talk. People following the situation have heard rumours Oxford Biomedica may have attracted fresh takeover interest. Earlier this year it emerged that EQT - the Scandinavian private equity firm backed by the billionaire Wallenberg family - approached Oxford Biomedica with a takeover approach following the publication of an UNCOOKED Alert by Betaville Intelligence . The approach from EQT was rejected by Oxford Biomedica's board and the buy out firm walked away from a potential transaction. Betaville Intelligence subsequently reported that EQT had offered 920p a share for Oxford Biomedica. People following the situation said it isn't clear whether EQT is the suitor circling Oxford Biomedica, which is due unveil financial figures next Tuesday (September 22 2026), this time round. It's possible a rival buy out firm or a trade buyer may be eyeing the business, said people following the situation. To be clear, the above story is UNCOOKED . In case you don't remember I have pasted the definition of UNCOOKED below: UNCOOKED: Market gossip as Betaville receives it. This scuttlebutt has just come in and hasn't been checked with all of Betaville's well-informed RARE sources let alone formal journalistic channels (public relations executives, bankers etc). The rumour might be total codswallop, nonsense or rubbish - but then again there may be something in it, so it's worth airing on Betaville.

Empresas y etiquetas relacionadas: Oxford Biomedica
